content: {"reasoning":"Required prior authorization is missing, and the 30-day retroauthorization window has closed, so another retroauthorization request is not permitted. There is no denial to appeal, and the payer does not offer peer-to-peer review. Neither submitting records nor correcting claim data resolves the authorization barrier, and billing the full balance to the patient or secondary payer is not justified at this stage; specialist review is needed to identify a permissible recovery path.","action":"escalate"}
